mapper.select: select user_id, preferred_cities, preferred_areas, walk_styles, preferred_duration, mobility_level, avoid_tags, recent_suggested_areas, summary, created_at, updated_at from agent_user_memory where user_id = #{userId} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into agent_user_memory ( user_id, preferred_cities, preferred_areas, walk_styles, preferred_duration, mobility_level, avoid_tags, recent_suggested_areas, summary, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{userId}, #{preferredCities}, #{preferredAreas}, #{walkStyles}, #{preferredDuration}, #{mobilityLevel}, #{avoidTags}, #{recentSuggestedAreas}, #{summary}, now(), now() ) on duplicate key update preferred_cities = values(preferred_cities), preferred_areas = values(preferred_areas), walk_styles = values(walk_styles), preferred_duration = values(preferred_duration), mobility_level = values(mobility_level), avoid_tags = values(avoid_tags), recent_suggested_areas = values(recent_suggested_areas), summary = values(summary), updated_at = now()
